mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates supply-side constraints, which can lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where industrial production declined by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with increased real personal consumption expenditures.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation is rising, the real interest rate increases, which tightens financial conditions and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: rising inflation with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with a rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls decrease and the unemployment rate rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP combined with a rise in consumer price index signals strong economic growth with inflationary pressures, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings grow.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained increases in GDP and rising consumer price index.
